svg.aria-label: The citation-check mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Citation compliance agent, one pass: cross-check, format, DOI, retractions (agent); each issue (question); Corrected, logged (agent); Flagged for your review (agent); Revised wording suggested (agent); STOP: possible fabrication (stop); Removed, or kept with a note (agent); Citation audit report (agent) | paper, as built: Session asks: the claims not to make, the earlier papers, the result files [5.Q (i)] (stop); Script, run by the session: lookup.py cite-keys and check-urls [5.Q (i)] (script); Citation compliance agent, one pass: cross-check, format, DOI, retractions, each claim against the passage read in its source's full text, and the study's own results against the result files [5.Q (i)] (ruled); The citation style to confirm, when more than half the cited entries follow another style than the Citation Format row (stop); each issue (question); Corrected by patch, logged (agent); Flagged for your review (agent); Revised wording suggested (agent); A claim the run cannot support: the check stops at the first claim not held, and the stop is raised once the agent has ended [5.Q (i)] (stop); A reference that cannot be confirmed, only under strict [5.Q (i)] (stop); Removed, or kept with a note (agent); Script, run by the session: quote-check of each passage [5.Q (i)] (script); Citation audit report (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [5.Q (i)] (stop); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
